scientific_integrity: The claims are accompanied by a self-contained proof, literal finite checks and explicit attribution to prior theorems. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The general classification is proved only for the sharp parameter boundary n=2k+3 with k>=2 and two-subset Kneser graphs. Triangle-and-matching minima, the scalar threshold and full tuple classification are prior results. An equivalent account of the extra ordinary k-domination minimizers may exist in unindexed literature; independent mathematical assessment has not occurred.
title: The unique \(K_4\) exception to boundary \(k\)-domination in two-subset Kneser graphs
